text: In the hands of the Mother of learning… why a Veena along with a book?
Today, Kanakadurgamma on Indrakeeladri in Vijayawada will give darshan as Sri Saraswati Devi.
Goddess Saraswati is not only the deity of learning… but also of speech, music, and arts.
That is why we also call the Goddess “Vagdevi”.
The book in the Goddess's hand signifies knowledge, and the Veena signifies music.
The Japamala reminds us of continuous practice.
In this form, there is a beautiful combination…
Education is not just about remembering things.
And also expressing them beautifully as an art.
Let us pray for increased interest in learning, intellect to understand, and concentration in practice.
The idea shown in the hands of the same Goddess — Saraswati worship.
